name: BTC Phishing
rootCause: On August 19, 2025, a Bitcoin holder lost 783 BTC (worth $91.4 million) to a social engineering scam. The attacker impersonated hardware wallet support, obtained wallet credentials, and transferred the funds. The stolen BTC was laundered through Wasabi Wallet to obscure the trail. The attacker impersonated a trusted hardware wallet support agent, deceived the victim into sharing wallet credentials, and used them to transfer 783 BTC out of the victim's wallet. There was no technical vulnerability in the wallet or protocol; the loss resulted from successful phishing/social engineering.
